ownershipDerivation.method: Resolved frozen legacy selectors, nativeEngineProductPaths owner records, reconciled non-product engine entries, and newPlannedFiles; retained development-only projection is excluded because it is retained unchanged.

waveExecutionPolicy.preflight: Before a wave starts, no path in its union allowlist may already be dirty. Completed-wave outputs and this packet/receipt are permitted evidence only.
waveExecutionPolicy.activeWaveGuard: While a wave is active, dirty paths may only be completed-wave outputs, this packet/receipt, and the union of every active lane allowlist. Do not apply a lane-local guard while M4 and M5 run together.
waveExecutionPolicy.barrier: After each wave, reconcile actual changes to the owning lane allowlist and reject missing, overlapping, foreign, or unplanned paths before a dependent wave starts.
waveExecutionPolicy.integrationBoundary: The integration owner verifies, stages, commits, pushes, and deploys without editing a lane-owned implementation path.

checks: allowlist-completeness
lane-disjointness
dependency-validity
maximum-safe-parallelization
end-to-end-lane-closure

stopConditions: M0 contract freeze, acceptance, ownership map, authority source, or source digest changes
M0 acceptance no longer reports PASS
a wave allowlist path is dirty before that wave starts
an active or completed wave changes a path outside the permitted union
a lane actual changed path set differs from its exact allowlist
a worker declares or requires an in-wave worker dependency
required signed installed-product qualification evidence is absent before M7
a requested edit would modify Membrane or a retained development-only path
